name: Shop Floor
description: The main floor of the shop: tall mismatched shelves packed two-deep, a rolling ladder on a brass rail, and a front display table Iris rearranges by mood. A fogged front window looks out on the wet street; the welcome mat by the door is permanently damp. Narrow aisles wind back toward the café counter.
example_text: Bookshop floor: leaning shelves, a rolling ladder, a front display table, a fogged street window.

properties.lighting: warm overhead lamps and grey daylight from the front window
